comments.headline: Benchmarking Application Missing from AEGB Review
comments.summary: Site plan designates project as not requiring Austin Energy Green Building Program rating, but the benchmarking application is absent from the submittal package, preventing verification of AEGB designation consistency.
comments.attn: Only one review run identified this (1 of 3 runs). Verify whether benchmarking application is required for projects not requiring AEGB rating.

details.text: Benchmarking application is not included in the submittal package. ZLU-20.25 requires verification that the project's AEGB designation is consistent between site plan application and benchmarking documentation.
details.citation: ZLU-20.25; Austin Energy Green Building Program

runComments.comment: Site plan application correctly designates the project as not requiring Austin Energy Green Building Program rating. However, a benchmarking application is not present in the submittal package, preventing verification that the AEGB designation is consistent between the site plan application and benchmarking application as required by ZLU-20.25.
